limitations.note: The agent registered `number` but made it publish the newly computed count instead of the pre-edge `num` value that the existing `zero` register already sampled.
The rewrite changed `zero` from low to high during asynchronous reset, even though the original reset value should have been preserved.
The test expected increments and set values to appear on the same edge that updated the counter, so it validated the rewrite's timing instead of checking the required one-cycle output delay.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: Bundling a disallowed cleanup command with the edit and simulation prevented either from running and forced the agent to resubmit the whole batch.
